question: In 1976, in which Part of the Indian Constitution under Article 51A were Fundamental Duties added?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**IV A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fundamental Duties** were added to the Indian Constitution through the **42nd Amendment Act** in **1976**.
 
• The duties were introduced under **Part IV-A** of the Constitution and are listed in **Article 51A**.
